itemText: Wrap DELETE /stories/:id in a database transaction so a failed delete cannot leave orphaned partial state.
summary: Rewrote deleteStoryCascade to use db.batch([...]) (Neon HTTP driver has no db.transaction() support) so all 23 deletes/updates/raw-sql commit atomically. tsc clean, 4/4 tests pass (943/943 suite-wide). No subagent dispatch available this run (standing no-subagent instruction) -> self-implemented, not independently verified. file: packages/api/src/routes/delete-story-cascade.ts

itemText: Feed redo-round chat messages into the Plotter and Writer prompts.
summary: Added storyComments.appliedAt column (migration 0055) so unapplied chat comments (source=chat) are folded into gatherRedoFeedback's userFeedback block for both plan-redo and text-rewrite, then marked applied after a successful redo. tsc clean, 945/945 suite-wide (7 new/updated tests in gather-redo-feedback.test.ts). No independent review (no subagent dispatch this run). files: packages/api/src/routes/gather-redo-feedback.ts, pipeline-plan-redo.ts, pipeline-text-rewrite.ts, packages/core/src/db/schema.ts, migrations/0055_overjoyed_mikhail_rasputin.sql

itemText: Wrap chat/comment text in the existing data-only prompt delimiter before it reaches Plotter/Writer.
summary: Added packages/core/src/pipeline/wrap-user-data-block.ts (matches the existing memorable-moments.ts labeled-block pattern) and wired it around options.userAnnotations in writer.ts:127 and options.userFeedback in plotter.ts:171 - the two one-shot generation call sites where injection risk is real. Deliberately left pipeline-questions.ts's plan-chat endpoint out of scope: that endpoint is a genuine back-and-forth conversation where the user's text is SUPPOSED to instruct the assistant, so the same not-instructions wrap would break the feature rather than harden it - it needs a different, not-yet-designed treatment. tsc clean, 949/949 suite-wide (3 new tests: writer.test.ts, new plotter.test.ts, new wrap-user-data-block.test.ts). No independent review (no subagent dispatch this run).
